quirks.description: Startup can still hang before War3Log opens. On 20 October 2026 clone-a's first launch from a client-service Battle.net reached the menu; each of two doctor recoveries after a crash passed through one hung startup before reaching the menu.

Moving ORIGIN_FRAME_CHAT_MSG with BlzFrameClearAllPoints and BlzFrameSetAbsPoint crashed the game about 20 s into a four-fighter match in both runs that moved it (ACCESS_VIOLATION); the same map without the move played two minutes.
